subject: Quick follow-up from Inference Summit - FintechX inference needs
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@fintechx.com>
Date: 2027-04-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Quick follow-up from Inference Summit - FintechX inference needs

Hi Emily -

Great to meet you at the Inference Summit yesterday - loved your talk on low-latency fraud detection. Thanks for taking a few minutes to chat about FintechX's plans to move more scoring and routing logic to LLM-based models.

Per our conversation, I wanted to share a quick one-pager on Redwood's approach (batching, KV cache, private deployment options) and propose a short discovery call next week to map your latency and throughput targets so we can recommend the right serving profile.

Attachments: redwood-one-pager.pdf

Next steps I propose:
- 30m discovery call (I can include an engineer)
- Quick throughput/latency targets + sample request profile from your team
- We'll share a mutual action plan and an initial cost estimate

Are you available Wed 4/14 or Thu 4/15 in the morning PT? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0198

On a related note: I've cc'd Rajesh in case you want to loop in platform/infra details for the discovery call.

From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@fintechx.com>
Date: 2027-04-11T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from Inference Summit - FintechX inference needs

Hi Marissa -

Great meeting you as well - thanks for the one-pager. Wed 4/14 at 10am PT works for me and I'll invite our infra lead Rajesh so he can share current throughput and deployment constraints.

For context, we're evaluating replacing a portion of our rule-based scoring (peak 200 req/s, p95 latency target 120ms) and want to understand the economics of different deployment modes (hosted vs dedicated vs private).

See you on 4/14 - I'll send a calendar invite.

Best,
Emily
Director of Platform Engineering | FintechX
emily.zhang@fintechx.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@fintechx.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-14T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up from Inference Summit - FintechX inference needs

Thanks again for the call this morning - great alignment. Quick recap and agreed next steps below.

--- DISCOVERY RECAP ---
Customer goals:
- Replace rule-based scoring for fraud detection for specific flows (payments, logins)
- Maintain p95 latency <= 120ms at peak 200 req/s
- Prefer private deployment for PCI-sensitive flows but open to hybrid approach

Current constraints:
- On-prem Kubernetes cluster in us-west, limited GPU quota
- Tight audit/compliance window; will need SOC2 evidence and KMS integration

Agreed next steps:
1) Redwood: share Mutual Action Plan + preliminary cost estimate for two options (hosted + dedicated) - attached.
2) FintechX: share a small sample of request/response payloads and existing p95 metrics by EOD 4/16.
3) Redwood infra (Nikhil) to review compat with on-prem K8s and KMS options; we'll propose a short tech sync 4/19.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-fintechx.xlsx

If you're good with the MAP, we'll schedule the technical sync. Rajesh - feel free to add any missing constraints.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@fintechx.com>
Cc: Rajesh Menon <rajesh.menon@fintechx.com>, Nikhil Sharma <nikhil.sharma@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Checking in - MAP and tech sync timing

Hi Emily -

Wanted to bump this thread in case the MAP or tech sync timing slipped on your side. We haven't received the sample payloads yet and wanted to confirm whether the project is still a priority for FintechX in the next 60 days.

If priorities shifted, no problem - just let me know and we can pause the MAP work. If it's still a go, can you confirm:
- ETA for sample payloads / p95 metrics
- A 30m slot for a tech sync week of 4/19 (we suggested 4/19 previously)

If easier, happy to take a quick 10m call to align on timing.

Thanks - hope the quarter-end is wrapping up smoothly.

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0198
